messages:
Ankur: FYI — putting this here to sync on the tenant isolation + RBAC reshuffle for console queries.
Jeni: thanks. quick summary: we want to collapse the current two auth checks (gateway & panel) into a single authz layer upstream of the fanout to cut per-request latency.
Maria: what's the impact on dashboards that rely on ad-hoc cross-tenant joins? any feature regressions?
Ankur: good point. plan is to keep surface semantics identical. upstream authz will return a tenant-mask token we propagate to the query workers; workers will enforce at storage-access only.
Oliver: so workers won't run auth logic, just check the mask. that should be faster. how do we generate the mask securely?
Jeni: mask is HMAC'ed and scoped per-route+model. private key lives in KMS on control plane. workers have read-only verify keys rotated via the agent.
Ankur: prototype numbers: removed auth check from worker path -> ~12% p99 latency reduction on dashboard renders with many small panels.
Maria: sounds good but we need a migration plan. parallel run? fallback to current checks if mask missing?
Jeni: yes: canary rollout with header present optional. gateway will start emitting X-Tenant-Mask; workers check header if present, else run legacy path. Toggled via config flag.
Oliver: what about caching? current per-panel cache keys include user perms. with mask we can simplify to mask-based keys which should increase hit rate.
Ankur: exactly. more cache locality expected. also makes batching simpler since auth-decisions are off the hot path.
Maria: ops concerns: if control plane KMS is unavailable, can workers still validate? needs graceful degrade.
Jeni: workers will fall back to legacy inline auth if verification fails or key not present. we surfaced a monitoring metric authz.verify.failures for early alerts.
sre-bot: Deploy window scheduled Thu 03:00 UTC. Expect brief spike in authz.verify.failures during rollout. :bell:
Oliver: does this change any SLOs? we need to update docs and runbook to reflect new single-point auth source.
Ankur: SLOs unchanged but runbook updated: new step to check control-plane key sync and X-Tenant-Mask header presence.
Maria: let's draft RFC follow-up with migration steps, rollout gating (traffic %, metrics), and security signoff. I'll own the doc.
Jeni: I'll attach perf graphs and cache-hit projections to the RFC.
Ankur: ok, next sync after RFC is ready. thanks all :thumbsup:
